title: Ledger Row
description: One JSONL line in the influence ledger. Pipeline Spec §10.3 verbatim: (pair_added, action_id, speaker, role, outcome_id, req_id, score, kind).

pair_added.description: The pair whose pipeline pass produced this score row.

action_id.description: Action identifier, e.g. U(1,3) or A(1,12).

speaker.description: U = user, A = AI. Matches the action_id prefix.

role.description: The action's role classification from Step 1a.

outcome_id.description: Which outcome this score belongs to, e.g. 'outcome 1'.

req_id.description: Which requirement within the outcome, e.g. 'req 1'. Always read as (outcome_id, req_id) together.

score.description: The influence score I(a→r). Creation actions receive 5 by rule; labeled actions 1–5 by Step 3.

kind.description: How this row was produced: creation (Step 2 create op), labeled (Step 3 label), slot-origin (Step 2 resolve op).
